description:
Sitemap URL Extractor — every URL in a site's sitemaps

Extract every URL from a site's XML sitemaps: robots.txt discovery, nested sitemap indexes, gzip and RSS/Atom feeds, with lastmod, changefreq, priority, image count and hreflang alternates. Optional HTTP status check per URL. $0.30 per 1,000 URLs.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): URL extracted: $0.0003; URL status checked: $0.0005.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/sitemap-url-extractor.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

checkStatus.description: Send a HEAD request (GET fallback) to each delivered URL and fill in statusCode, so you can spot 404s and redirects. Billed separately at $0.50 per 1,000 checked URLs.
checkStatus.title: Check HTTP status of every URL

excludePatterns.description: Drop URLs matching any of these regular expressions. Example: \.(jpg|png|pdf)$ or /tag/. Excludes are applied after includes.
excludePatterns.title: Exclude patterns (regex)

includePatterns.description: Keep only URLs matching at least one of these regular expressions. Example: /blog/ to keep blog URLs only. Empty = keep everything.
includePatterns.title: Include patterns (regex)

lastmodAfter.description: ISO date (2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T12:00:00Z). Keeps only sitemap entries whose <lastmod> is on or after this date. Entries without a lastmod are dropped when this is set.
lastmodAfter.title: Only URLs modified after

maxSitemaps.description: How many sitemap files (index children included) one run may read (1-10,000). Default 200 is plenty for almost every site.
maxSitemaps.title: Max sitemaps to read

maxUrls.description: Hard cap on delivered URL rows (1-1,000,000). The run stops as soon as it is reached, so a default run stays cheap. Charged at $0.0003 per delivered URL.
maxUrls.title: Max URLs to deliver

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Sitemaps are public, so no proxy is used by default. Add an Apify proxy for sites that block datacenter IPs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

requestTimeoutSecs.description: How long to wait for a sitemap or robots.txt response (5-300 seconds).
requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)

startUrls.description: Website roots (https://example.com) or direct sitemap URLs (https://example.com/sitemap.xml). For a site root the actor reads robots.txt for Sitemap: lines and then tries /sitemap.xml, /sitemap_index.xml, /sitemap-index.xml and /wp-sitemap.xml.
startUrls.title: Start URLs

name: sitemap_urls
